roles.description: Bounded implementation authority. Dispatch for delegated bounded implementation or execution, including ambient work. Contracts apply only to locked or explicitly contracted work; attaching Alchemist opens none. Escalate changed requirements, public boundaries, or material tradeoffs. Not for undecided meaning or independent assurance.
Independent read-only assurance. Dispatch for review of any work Legion did not do itself, and for independent verification of someone else's work. Never implements or certifies its own fix.

Cross-cutting design and adjudication authority. Dispatch when a material unresolved choice exceeds routine capability judgment, ownership or boundary is disputed, reassessment is needed before expensive commitment, or repeated repairs fail. Explicit Sage requests attach. Routine capability judgment stays with its capability.

Dispatch for explicitly requested mechanical watchdog checkpoints using independently scheduled wakes, per-target state, and verbatim Oracle directives. No semantic judgment, implementation, or certification.
